overview_description.description: Minro provides a B2B SaaS platform that helps product-led companies transform raw user telemetry into actionable customer success workflows. The platform connects to tools like PostHog and other data sources to automatically identify users, enrich profiles, and build unified customer views. It applies identity resolution and behavioral analysis to segment users, score churn risk, and highlight accounts that need attention. Customer teams can configure onboarding drop-off recovery, high-value user retention workflows, and automated outreach based on product usage patterns. Minro also offers AI-driven features to generate personalized emails, explore trends, and query customer data without writing SQL. Its tools are intended for founders, product managers, and customer success teams who want to understand who their users are, spot at-risk accounts early, and coordinate timely interventions within existing analytics and messaging stacks.
